query_analysis.original_query: I need to develop a predictive model for eutectic salt formation in our deep eutectic solvent-based extraction process for rare earth elements. Can you help me characterize the thermodynamic boundaries?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a predictive model to understand the thermodynamic behavior of eutectic salt formation during the extraction of rare earth elements using deep eutectic solvents, and provide a comprehensive characterization of the thermodynamic boundaries.

communication_strategy.information_flow: Model development and validation, with continuous feedback on extraction process parameters
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative model refinement and process optimization

clarification_questions: What specific rare earth elements are being extracted?
What are the compositions of the deep eutectic solvents used?
Are there any specific thermodynamic properties or phase behaviors you are interested in characterizing?
